scientific_limits: Kaliborite structure: total reflections3642 in p886 prose vs3842 in Table 1. The owner preserves this difference; no silently chosen total. H(1) difference density has two maxima about 0.7 angstrom apart; split model did not lower R. Dynamic disorder is interpretation, not a measured trajectory.

Kaliborite thermal material is an unspecified Wroclaw museum sample, not the Kazakhstan CMN53372 structure crystal. No accession, locality, quantitative purity, sample mass, atmosphere, hold times or replicate count is reported for this arm. The 2.5 degrees C/min statement is specifically the heat/cool structural examination arm.

Kaliborite thermal Table 1 prints a different amorphous bulk formula from Table 4. Table 1 diagram and Fig 2a(C) support qualitative phase assignments, not a balanced conversion or phase yield. The potassium-rich intermediate matrix is not treated as a measured pure compound. No new-product recovery or industrial process is demonstrated.

The 1994 thermal paper cites Stoch-Waclawska 1993 as reference 5; data reuse is possible and no independent replication is claimed. The full 1993 paper was not acquired. Its publisher abstract says dehydroxylation then dehydration, but also says dehydration precedes dehydroxylation; no precise ordering is imported.

Preobrazhenskite: abstract/Table 1 observed-reflection criterion is >=2.5sigma(I), p388 prints the opposite inequality. The p394 OH3 disorder paragraph switches to H6 labels in the final sentence. Source discrepancies are retained, not repaired by changing deposited coordinates.

Preobrazhenskite H6 is a symmetric average model; p395 explicitly questions true symmetry and proposes off-centre disorder/possible high-temperature behavior without testing it. Fig 7/Table 6 fit five IR components; the fit is not five resolved experimental peaks. Table 6 lowest component3204cm-1 versus prose3203 is not imported as a precision claim.

No original measured structure-factor files acquired for either1994 structure. COD files are attributable derivatives and cannot independently establish new chemical analyses, corrected H sites or crystallographic dynamics.

Paternoite alias literature and later2015 kaliborite spectroscopy (DOI 10.1080/00387010.2014.991974, discovery lead only) were not promoted to additional experiments. The full1965 alias article was not acquired. No claim that this bounded search exhausts borate literature.
